title: Credit Builder Accounts Locked Savings Certificate Terms
content:
## Terms

1. The locked savings certificate of a Credit Builder account earns the plan's annual percentage yield (0.1 percent on every Credit Builder Accounts plan), credited monthly on the last day of the month as the savings balance times the APY divided by 1200, rounded to the cent (nothing when it rounds to 0.00).
2. Dividends are credited only while the account is active.
3. Savings cannot be withdrawn, pledged elsewhere or used to make payments while the account is open; they leave the certificate only when the account closes.

## Questions the terms answer

**Is a dividend credited for a month in which the account matured or closed before the last day?** Dividends are credited only while the account is active; on the last day of that month the account is no longer active, so no dividend is credited.

**Can the savings cover a missed monthly payment?** No. While the account is open the savings cannot be used to make payments.

**Can the borrower take part of the savings out early?** No. The savings leave the certificate only when the account closes.

## Dividend illustration (hypothetical balance)

A certificate holding 2400.00 on the last day of a month in which the account stays active is credited 2400.00 times 0.1 divided by 1200, that is 0.20.
